page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated CPU allocation without hyper-threading. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication for distributed systems. The lack of integrated local storage and GPU accelerators represents a trade-off, positioning this instance primarily for workloads that rely on network-attached storage and standard CPU-bound processing.

Given its balanced resource allocation and dedicated CPU cores, the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is suited for enterprise applications, web serving, mid-sized databases, and general-purpose business workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation offers predictable performance, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for workloads requiring consistent compute power without the overhead of shared-core resource contention.
